fields.title: Every check and every publish runs from a workflow in this repository

sections.Summary: One workflow gates a pull request. The others publish what has merged: the tool to nuget.org, each corpus to GitHub Packages, the plugins to the `marketplace` branch, and the site to GitHub Pages. A job declares what it may do before it does it, pins the actions it runs, and stores no credential of its own. Those three rules are [OpenSSF Scorecard](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/checks.md)'s `Token-Permissions`, `Pinned-Dependencies` and `Dangerous-Workflow` checks. A checkout leaves no credential for a later step, which is [zizmor](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#artipacked)'s `artipacked` audit. [actionlint](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint) decides the rest of how a workflow is written.
sections.Conformance checklist:
- [ ] `actionlint` passes.
- [ ] Every job in `kac.yml` is named in `validate`'s `needs:`.
- [ ] Every `uses:` in `.github/workflows/` and `template/.github/workflows/` names a commit SHA.
- [ ] Every checkout sets `persist-credentials: false`, and every step needing git write access supplies the token.
- [ ] Every workflow declares `permissions: contents: read` at its top level.
- [ ] Every job with a write permission has a step that uses it.
- [ ] No secret appears in a workflow's text, and no step prints one.
- [ ] Every publishing job declares `timeout-minutes`, and every package publish sits behind a verifying job.
- [ ] Every observable change to `kac` here has its line under `## Unreleased`.
- [ ] A pull request moving `<Version>` has the branch owner's decision behind it, and has renamed `## Unreleased`.
- [ ] Every corpus whose export changed has moved its `content-version`.
